title: Console: Density Mode for Cost Tiles & Rollout Timeline — review and handoff
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce a user-selectable 'Density mode' across the Console cost dashboard and rollout timeline that compresses card spacing, reduces chrome, and reflows metrics so power users can scan more routes and tokens per view. This ticket covers final visual polish, accessibility review, prototype validation with stakeholders, and engineering handoff for responsive breakpoints and animation sequencing. Aim: improve information density without losing clarity or increasing token misinterpretation in cost charts.
acceptance_criteria: Compact density toggle exists and persists per-user in Console settings (persisted by backend flag).
Cost tiles reduce vertical padding by 40% and hide tertiary microcopy at < 720px width while preserving primary metrics.
Rollout timeline switches to condensed lane view with stacked micro-indicators when density mode enabled; hover reveals full labels.
Prototype validated by PM and two engineers with no major interaction blockers.
Automated accessibility checks pass (contrast, focus order) and manual keyboard/voiceover spot checks completed.
Handoff doc includes responsive CSS tokens, motion timing, and known edge cases; ENG has an implementation plan and estimates.
design_links: Token doc: color / spacing / elevation adjustments for density
Iconography: condensed collapse/expand glyphs — updated SVGs attached
comments: 2025-02-11 Ava Martinez: Initial draft prototypes uploaded. Focused on three density levels: Comfortable, Compact, Dense. Added toggle in top-right corner of dashboard to preview.
2025-02-12 Samir Patel (PM): Reviewed. Request to ensure the toggle is discoverable for new users and default remains Comfortable. Also asked for telemetry events to measure usage.
2025-02-13 Clara Nguyen: Ran prototype with ENG-4821; noted that KV cache util card needs to preserve single-line truncate for model names at dense widths.
2025-02-14 Jonah Reed (Eng): Flagged potential performance cost of hover tooltips for every condensed item; suggested conditional tooltip creation only on pointer devices.
2025-02-16 Accessibility review (Maya Li): Manual audit done — suggested focus ring adjustments and removing hover-only affordances; added voiceover hint strings for condensed timeline lanes.
2025-02-17 Ava Martinez: Updated motion timings and added a short transition for tile reflow. Uploaded updated figma and loom.
review_feedback: PM (Samir Patel): Keep default as Comfortable; density should be an opt-in power feature. Add short in-product tooltip pointing to the setting after first use.
Engineering (Jonah Reed): Avoid constructing 300+ tooltip DOM nodes. Implement virtualized hover regions or a single floating tooltip bound to active element.
Accessibility (Maya Li): Ensure all condensed items are reachable by keyboard; set aria-expanded on timeline lanes and provide explicit off-screen labels for stacked indicators.
Design Review (Lara Chen): Visual weight of primary value must remain constant across density modes; adjust type token scaling rather than color to preserve hierarchy.
decisions: Toggle will be client-enabled with server-side persistence (feature flag + user preference).
Implement a single shared tooltip component for dense views to mitigate performance issues.
Hide tertiary microcopy at < 720px when density is enabled; show on hover/focus.
Use existing spacing tokens but introduce density variants (spacing-compact, spacing-dense) to avoid token multiplication.
dev_handoff_notes: Provide CSS variables: --spacing-compact = 8px, --spacing-dense = 4px; update tokens file in repo.
Tile padding change: comfortable 16px -> compact 10px -> dense 6px.
Rollout timeline: implement stacked indicators using CSS grid with aria-labels; max 3 visible markers, rest collapsed into '+N' node with accessible label.
Tooltip: single floating React portal positioned from pointer events; only mounted on pointer devices. Fallback for keyboard: focus triggers tooltip content via aria-describedby.
Edge cases: long model names should truncate with middle ellipsis at widths < 360px. Add unit tests for truncation utility.
qa_tasks: Validate density toggle persistence across sessions and devices.
Verify keyboard navigation through condensed tiles and timeline lanes; test with VoiceOver/NVDA.
Check that telemetry events fire: density_toggle_enabled, density_toggle_disabled, density_usage_event.
Confirm rollouts timeline correctly stacks indicators and exposes full labels on hover/focus.
visual_specs: Primary value: Inter var font-size remains 16px across modes; secondary caption scales -1px per density step.
Color tokens unchanged; use elevation token elevated-1 when density is off and elevated-0 when dense to reduce visual clutter.
Icons: compressed 16px glyphs for dense mode; ensure 24px tap targets preserved via hit slop.
motion_specs: Tile reflow: 150ms ease-out for position, 120ms fade for microcopy.
Toggle state: 180ms scale + color fade for affordance; provide reduced-motion fallback that disables transitions.
Rollout lane expand/collapse: 200ms height animation with easing curve cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1).
accessibility_notes: No hover-only interactions required to access essential info. All condensed labels reveal on focus.
Ensure color contrast of collapsed '+N' indicator meets 4.5:1 against background.
Add aria-controls and aria-expanded on timeline lanes; include aria-live polite region for dynamic '+N' changes.
next_steps: ENG-4821 implement prototype components (estimated 3 sprint days).
PM to add telemetry events to tracking plan (PM-227).
Design to produce final export-ready icons and updated token patch for the repo by 2025-02-20.
Schedule short validation session with two internal product teams to observe density mode usage (target week of 2025-02-24).
